seo.title: Ocean Freight & International Shipping
seo.description: Autumn Star arranges ocean freight worldwide, plus air freight, ground transportation and freight coordination for importers, exporters and growing businesses. Request a quote.

hero.title: Moving Business Across Borders.
hero.text: Ocean freight worldwide, plus air, ground and the coordination that connects them. Tell us what you're shipping and we'll plan the move.

services.text: Ocean freight leads. Air, ground, coordination and supply chain support fill in the rest of the route.
